Deployment & verification (start.sh, localhost:3000) -> 5. Documentation. Benchmark annotation: expert workflow drafting -> Claude Code-assisted refinement -> human quality control

Functional Score (FS): proportion of passed functional verification nodes executed by the GUI agent verifier; category-wise test-case pass rates; Deployment Success Rate (DSR, reported for reference, not an official metric)
None

Visual Score (VS): VLM-judge component-level fidelity to prototypes (0/0.25/0.5/0.75/1 per component, averaged); device-wise static scores (desktop, tablet, mobile); verifier agreement with humans

Automatic: GUI agent verifier (WebVoyager protocol, GLM-4.6V) executes expert-designed test workflows on the deployed site; VLM judge (Gemini-3-Pro-Preview) scores visual fidelity; containerized environment; deployment via agent-generated start.sh (up to three iterations, > 10 minutes or errors = failure). Manual: human validation of verifier on ~100 workflows (250 nodes) and of the judge on 100 prototypes

Tasks: 193 Vision2Web tasks at three levels. Configurations: 8 models x 2 frameworks (Claude Code, OpenHands). Baseline: none beyond alternatives. Held constant: container with runtimes (no MCP, terminal and file tools only), inputs in the working directory, level-specific prompt templates, deployment rule (start.sh on a fixed port, up to three iterations, 10-minute limit), same verifiers. Acceptance tests: expert-designed test workflows executed by the GUI agent plus VLM visual judge. Repetitions: Not stated (one run per configuration reported). Human intervention: none

Performance drops with task level for all agents. Claude-Opus-4.5 strongest overall (OpenHands full-stack VS/FS 38.4/57.6); Gemini-3-Pro-Preview best on static pages (OpenHands desktop 63.3) but weak on full-stack (11.7/22.6); Seed-1.8-VL 0 on full-stack, Qwen models near 0. Tablet/mobile 10-20% lower than desktop. OpenHands tends to outperform Claude Code for most non-Claude models. Public Service websites easiest, SaaS hardest; State Management, CRUD and File & Media operations weakest. No significance tests

Distinguished models, frameworks and levels. GUI verifier correct on 218/250 nodes (87.2%); VLM judge Spearman 0.66 mean (median 0.80) vs human inter-annotator 0.78; four VLM judges give the same ranking; two GUI verifier backbones differ by 0.31 FS (1.0%). Repeatability of agent runs not assessed. Limitations stated: residual verifier errors, website-only scope, costly evaluation

Limitations: automated GUI-agent and VLM verification may leave residual errors; focus on website development only; multimodal evaluation costly. Gaps: agents weak in cross-modal reasoning, long-horizon planning, multi-page coordination, persistent state and fine-grained requirement following; joint optimization of models and frameworks needed

Values from Table 3 (p. 7), layout scrambled; desktop values listed separately and rows rebuilt; several Avg values differ from the mean of VS and FS (e.g. OpenHands + Sonnet-4.5 full-stack Avg 20.4 vs (15.7+23.9)/2 = 19.8; OpenHands + Seed interactive 20.2 vs 20.7). Finding 3 says Opus-4.5 'consistently' strongest, but Gemini-3-Pro is best on static pages in both frameworks. Sensitivity analysis uses other systems (Claude-Sonnet-4.6, GPT-5.4, Kimi-K2.5, Gemini-3.1-Pro) not in Table 3; their framework not stated.
